control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
controlled removal of isolation and return to service
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at P-3221 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-3221 and PT-3221 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during shift handover while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 9 March 2008 an incident occurred on P-3221 and PT-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
